name: Eye level
text: eye-level shot, straight-on view

name: Worm's-eye
text: worm's-eye view from the ground, extreme upward perspective

name: Ground level
text: ground-level camera resting on the floor, foreground surface stretching away toward the subject

name: Low angle
text: low-angle shot from below, looking up, towering perspective

name: Knee level
text: knee-level camera height, slight upward view, legs and ground prominent in the frame

name: Hip level
text: hip-level camera height, casual slightly upward perspective, as if shot from the hip

name: Shoulder level
text: shoulder-level camera just above the eye line, gentle downward look at the subject

name: High angle
text: high-angle shot from above, looking down

name: Overhead close
text: close overhead view looking straight down from just above the subject, top of the head and shoulders visible

name: Bird's-eye
text: bird's-eye view, seen from directly above

name: Top-down flat lay
text: top-down overhead view, flat lay composition

name: Drone aerial
text: aerial drone shot, seen from high above, sweeping landscape below

name: Helicopter view
text: aerial view from a helicopter, wide oblique angle over the land, distant horizon visible

name: Airplane window
text: view from an airplane window, rounded window frame edge, clouds and patchwork land far below

name: Satellite view
text: satellite view straight down from orbit, landscape reduced to map-like shapes, textures and colors

name: Front view
text: frontal view, subject facing the camera head-on, shoulders square to the lens

name: Three-quarter view
text: three-quarter view, turned slightly toward the camera

name: Low three-quarter
text: low three-quarter angle, camera below and off to one side, subject looming at a diagonal

name: High three-quarter
text: high three-quarter angle, camera above and off to one side, looking down diagonally on the subject

name: Side profile
text: side view in profile

name: Rear three-quarter
text: rear three-quarter view, seen from behind and to one side, face partly turned away

name: From behind
text: view from behind, back to the camera

name: Over the shoulder
text: over-the-shoulder shot, out-of-focus shoulder in the foreground

name: First-person POV
text: first-person point of view, seen through the viewer's eyes

name: Helmet cam
text: helmet-mounted action camera view, wide first-person angle, hands and gear bouncing at the bottom of the frame

name: Child's eye level
text: seen from a child's eye level, adults and furniture towering overhead, tabletops above the eye line

name: Pet's eye level
text: seen from a pet's eye level just above the floor, feet and furniture legs looming around

name: Through a window
text: seen through a window from outside, glass reflections and window frame edges around the view

name: Through a doorway
text: viewed through an open doorway from the next room, door frame and dim wall edges in the foreground

name: Through foliage
text: seen through dense foliage, blurred leaves and branches partly hiding the view, hidden observer feel

name: Through a keyhole
text: view through a keyhole, scene visible only inside a keyhole-shaped opening, darkness all around

name: Door peephole
text: view through a door peephole, round fisheye bulge, dark rim, visitor swelling toward the center

name: Through binoculars
text: view through binoculars, two overlapping circles of sight, black surround, distant subject brought close

name: Around a corner
text: peeking around a corner, blurred wall edge covering one side of the frame, subject unaware

name: Through a crowd
text: seen through a gap in a crowd, blurred heads and shoulders framing the view

name: From the audience
text: view from the audience seats, rows of heads in the foreground, {stage|field|arena} ahead

name: Mirror reflection
text: seen reflected in a mirror, mirror frame edges visible, reversed view of the scene

name: Puddle reflection
text: seen in a rain puddle reflection at ground level, upside-down world, rippled wet edges

name: Inside a car
text: seen from inside a car through the windshield, dashboard edge and wipers in the foreground

name: Passenger seat
text: from the passenger seat, driver in profile, side window and passing road beyond

name: Under a table
text: view from under a table, table legs and edge framing the room beyond, chairs and feet nearby

name: From a balcony
text: from a high balcony, railing in the foreground, looking down onto the {street|courtyard|square} below

name: Bottom of a well
text: from the bottom of a deep well, looking straight up a round stone shaft to a circle of sky

name: Inside the fridge
text: view from inside an open fridge, shelves and jars in the foreground, someone peering in, glowing interior

name: Security camera
text: security camera view from a high ceiling corner, wide angle looking down across the room

name: Underwater looking up
text: underwater view looking up at the surface, rippling light and dark shapes floating above

name: Half underwater
text: split view at the waterline, half above and half below the water surface, wet lens edge between

name: Dutch angle
text: dutch angle, tilted camera, dynamic diagonal composition

name: Extreme canted
text: extreme canted angle, horizon tilted steeply to nearly forty-five degrees, disorienting off-balance view

name: Upside-down
text: upside-down view, camera flipped, floor or ground running along the top of the frame

name: Follow cam
text: follow camera behind the subject, moving with them, back and shoulders in frame, path opening ahead

name: Leading cam
text: camera leading in front of the subject, moving backward as they walk toward the lens

name: Side tracking
text: side-on tracking view, camera moving alongside the subject at the same speed, background streaming past

name: Low tracking
text: low tracking view skimming just above the ground, close to feet or wheels, ground rushing by

name: Orbiting view
text: orbiting camera circling around the subject, background sweeping past, subject held in the center

name: Top-down spin
text: top-down view looking straight down, camera slowly rotating above the scene

name: Crane rising
text: crane view rising from near the ground to a high vantage, the scene opening up below

name: Low flyover
text: low flyover gliding forward over the terrain, landscape sliding beneath the camera

name: Car-mounted
text: camera mounted on the side of a moving vehicle, body panel in the foreground, road blurring past
